profile.headline: SWE @ JPMC | Texas Alum
profile.summary:
Hi, I'm Andrew! I thrive on continuous learning and relish every opportunity that pushes me out of my comfort zone. I'm particularly drawn to challenges that allow me to apply my software engineering expertise and contribute to impactful projects. Collaborating with diverse teams to solve complex problems fuels my enthusiasm and brings out my best work.

If you have an exciting opportunity where I can leverage my skills and passion for software engineering, I'd love to connect and explore how we can create something remarkable together. Feel free to reach out at andrewmkim6@gmail.com.
